section1.title: Acceptance of Terms
section1.content: By registering as an agent partner, you agree to comply with all terms and conditions outlined in this agreement. These terms govern your relationship with Admission Desk and your conduct as a representative of partner institutions.

section2.title: Agent Responsibilities
section2.content: Agents agree to represent partner institutions honestly and professionally, comply with all applicable laws and regulations, maintain accurate student records, and process applications in a timely manner.

section3.title: Commission and Payment
section3.content: Commission rates are as agreed upon between the agent and Admission Desk. Payments will be processed according to the schedule outlined in your agent agreement.

section4.title: Termination
section4.content: Either party may terminate this agreement with written notice. Upon termination, all pending commissions will be settled according to the terms of your agent agreement.
